notes: nm IDENTITY Nebius Group N.V. (Netherlands), 20-F filer, Class A ordinary shares listed on Nasdaq as NBIS (USD quote, USD reporting, FY end 31 Dec); IBKR contract id 88819736 (NASDAQ, STK); no ADR (direct share). Class B shares exist (10-K EPS note: two-class, equal economics). Cover/20-F filed 2026-04-30 for FY2025.

nm RECONCILIATION FY2025 20-F text vs prefetch pf_ facts: revenue 529.8 matches; capex 4,066.0 matches; SBC 83.2 matches; diluted shares 247,679,946 matches. DIFFERENCES: CFO 20-F MD&A text says 401.9M vs companyfacts/AV 384.8M (17.1M, probable continuing vs total or restricted cash classification, not resolved); FY2024 revenue 20-F recast 91.5M (discontinued ops: Avride etc. recast) vs companyfacts/AV 117.5M; FY2024 SBC 54.5M (20-F) vs 56.6M (pf); FY2025 operating loss pf -611.7M vs AV -596.2M (15.5M apart, not resolved); FY2025 net income 82.5M (pf) vs 101.7M (AV; AV includes discontinued ops).

nm RECONCILIATION latest quarter (Q2 2026, 6-K release): revenue 582.3M, net loss from continuing ops -190.4M, adj EBITDA 236.2M, capex 5,657.4M all match AV quarterly; Q2 2026 balance sheet and CFO come from AV only (no 10-Q for a 20-F filer; the interim 6-K was read via release exhibit only), so quarterly CFO 2,246.1M (Q2) and 2,258.0M (Q1) are unreconciled and driven by customer prepayments (guidance: over 9B prepayments in 2026).

nm ROIC CHECK prefetch roic_last -8.7% (FY2025 NOPAT -434M on invested capital 5.0B) uses year-end 2025; since then equity rose 4.6B to 10.3B and debt 5.0B to 10.1B (Q2 2026) while cash is 8.0B: invested capital is now far larger, much of it construction in progress (capex 8.1B in H1 2026) not yet earning; ROIC on today's capital is not meaningful yet. Cash 8.04B includes customer prepayments (liability) and AV lists 1.62B long-term investments not in cash; restricted cash unknown. Operating leases/capital leases 1.51B counted in AV total debt 10.06B.

Monthly closes: 2025-10 130.82, 2025-11 94.87, 2025-12 83.70, 2026-03 103.76, 2026-06 276.17, 2026-09 235.88, 2026-10-01 154.14 (month-open series). No corporate actions returned. nm OWN MULTIPLE HISTORY not meaningful: GAAP diluted EPS FY2024 -2.28, FY2025 +0.33 (only from non-operating gains: operating loss -611.7M), FY2026 consensus EPS -2.11 and FY2027 -6.16, so trailing and forward P/E have no low/median/high; listed since Oct 2024 (history 2024-08 onward only). Price/sales instead: price 155.69 x 280.4M shares / TTM revenue 1,355.1M (Q3'25 146.1 + Q4'25 227.7 + Q1'26 399.0 + Q2'26 582.3) = about 32x; on FY2025 revenue 529.8M about 82x; on consensus FY2026 revenue 3.35B about 13x, FY2027 12.2B about 3.6x. Sources nm_ib_price, nm_av_income, nm_av_estimates.

nm CONSENSUS Alpha Vantage aggregated analysts, retrieved 2026-11-01: FY2026 revenue avg 3.345B (n 21, 3.00-3.585B), FY2027 12.24B (n 22, 8.81-17.99B: very wide), EPS FY2026 -2.11 (n 9, -6.41 to +0.49), FY2027 -6.16 (n 10, -15.31 to +5.27); EPS revisions down: FY2027 avg moved -4.87 (90d ago) to -5.65 (30d) to -6.16 (now); FY2026 EPS -2.14 (90d) to -2.52 (30d) to -2.11 (now). Q3 2026 (quarter ended 2026-09-30, not reported yet): revenue 905.7M (n 17, 876.6-942.6M), EPS -1.24 (n 5); Q4 2026 revenue 1.462B (n 17, 1.09-1.71B). Consensus is an expectation, not a fact; the Q3 2026 release is still ahead.

nm AV rate limit: CASH_FLOW and EARNINGS_ESTIMATES first calls hit the per-second burst limit on 2026-11-01 (spacing, not the daily quota); each was repeated once with return_full_data=true and succeeded. INCOME_STATEMENT and BALANCE_SHEET OK. FMP statements and analyst endpoints not called (denied on this plan per session_capabilities).

nm TRACK RECORD revenue ratio not computable: the releases carry no quantitative revenue guidance and the shareholder letters give ARR/revenue targets only. ARR is the guided metric: year-end 2025 ARR 1.25B against guided 0.9-1.1B (ratio 1.25 vs mid 1.0B, 1 beat, 0 misses, n 1). Earlier guidance releases (Q3 2025 letter and before) not retrieved within budget: n is only 1. Management also raised YE2026 contracted power from more than 2.5 GW to more than 3 GW (Feb), more than 4 GW (May), 5 GW (Aug); the 2026 revenue 3.0-3.4B and ARR 7-9B and about 40% adj EBITDA margin guidance (May letter) are reaffirmed in Aug: these belong to gather_documents. So far the company raises rather than misses, but the sample is one ARR guide.

nm GUIDANCE PRESENT (for gather_documents, from letters read here) May 2026 letter: 2026 revenue 3.0-3.4B, YE ARR 7-9B, about 40% adj EBITDA margin, 800MW-1GW connected power at YE, contracted power more than 4 GW; Aug 2026 letter: reaffirms all full-year guidance, YE2026 contracted power 5 GW, over 9B customer prepayments in 2026, over 1 GW per year deployed from 2027; ARR 1.92B at end of March 2026, 3.0B at end of June 2026 (up 598% y/y). Capex Q1 2.47B, Q2 5.66B (H1 8.13B); no capex guidance in the letters read.

nm ONE-OFFS FY2025 SG&A includes a one-time 43.6M equipment loss during transportation (20-F); Q1 2026 net income 621.2M and Q2 2025 584.4M are far above operating results (non-operating gains, likely equity-stake revaluations such as ClickHouse/Toloka; not verified here), so net income of those quarters is not a run rate. 20-F flags a material weakness: IT general controls and revenue-recognition process documentation for TripleTen (about 10% of FY2025 revenue).

nm CITABILITY the Q2 2026 results (2026-08-12) are older than 2 days and citable; the next results (Q3 2026) have not been published as of 2026-11-01. The 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-01 6-Ks were not read (not earnings releases per the list; contents unknown).
